Over a 12-month follow-up period, a constant clinical improvement was observed despite tapering of immunosuppressive and symptomatic treatment. The patient was able to walk unassisted, to carry out usual activities including a full time job. He was still symptomatic for inconstant self-resolving stiffness in the morning (12 months mRS score was 1).
Symptoms markedly improved with clonazepam (up to 2. 5 mg/day) and gabapentin (up to 1. 200 mg/day).
